assessments.reasoning: §7.4.9 step 3 captures GetMethod's result in Completion. When lookup succeeds and yields a method, step 4.c captures Call's result in Completion. Step 5 processes the incoming throw before step 6 can propagate an inner throw.

challenge.method: Traced an abrupt return-property access and an abrupt callable return method through steps 3–6. Checked GetMethod's nullish and non-callable cases in §7.3.10, then examined the corresponding sequence in §7.4.11 AsyncIteratorClose.
challenge.results: Either inner throw reaches step 5 after the attempted lookup or call. An incoming normal completion instead allows the inner throw to propagate at step 6. A missing method exits at step 4.b, and AsyncIteratorClose can additionally await a successful return call.

limitations: Lookup and call effects can precede propagation. The claim is confined to the synchronous operation and the specified incoming and inner throw completions.
